# <test file><TAB><what fails>; fails upstream too
# A file that no longer exists fails CI; the line goes once the test passes upstream again.
# A line naming a workspace directory (ending in "/") skips that workspace's whole test run, for a suite
# Test files CI skips (.github/scripts/ci-test.ts): each one also fails in SpaceFleet's upstream repository,
# where this code is developed, so the failure is not caused by the public export. One line per file:
# whose failing cases change from run to run.
